newsitem.title: USA: SOCCER-MEXICO DEFEATS DENMARK IN U.S. CUP. [CORRECTED 11:58 GMT 19/1]
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MEXICO DEFEATS DENMARK IN U.S. CUP. [CORRECTED 11:58 GMT 19/1]

text.p: (Corrects times of last three goals scored).
Mexico defeated Denmark 3-1
(halftime 1-0) in the U.S. Cup soccer tournament Friday at
Jack Murphy Stadium.
Scoring
Mexico: Enrique Alfaro (40th minute), Luis Hernandez
(55th), Carlos Hermosillo (73rd)
Denmark: Brian Steen Nielsen (64th)
Attendance: 35,232
Lineups:
Mexico: Adolfo Rios; Pavel Pardo, Claudio Suarez, Duilio
Davino; Ramon Ramirez, Marcelino Bernal (Nicolas Ramirez, 78),
Benjamin Galindo, Alberto Coyote; Enrique Alfaro (Jose Manuel
Abundis, 81), Luis Roberto Alves (Luis Hernandez, 46), Carlos
Hermosillo (Luis Garcia, 78).
Denmark: Mogens Krogh; Soren Colding, Michael Hemmingsen,
Per Nielsen, Jens Jessen; Kim Daugaard (Peter Frank, 78),
Bjarne Goldbaek, Brian Steen Nielsen, Stig Tofting (Jesper
Thygesen, 46); Miklos Molnar (Soren Andersen, 68), Per
Pedersen (Peter Moller, 60).
